title: Patient Payment Plan Lowering Floor for Screened Households
content:
**Rule.** On a **Patient Payment Plan** installment change, the lowering floor is 10.00 dollars when the open application's household was screened at or below 200 percent of the federal poverty level and 20.00 dollars when it was screened above 200 and at or below 400 percent, each only on tiers whose minimum monthly payment is higher; otherwise it is the tier's minimum monthly payment.

**Open application.** A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. The screening is the household federal poverty level (FPL) percentage on that application in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).

| Tier | Tier minimum monthly payment (USD) | At or below 200% FPL | Above 200%, at or below 400% FPL | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 25.00 | 10.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 50.00 | 10.00 | 20.00 | 50.00 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 75.00 | 10.00 | 20.00 | 75.00 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 100.00 | 10.00 | 20.00 | 100.00 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 20.00 | 10.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |

At exactly 200 percent the 10.00 floor applies; at 200.5 percent the 20.00 floor; at exactly 400 percent still 20.00; above 400 percent the tier's minimum.
